title: Shared contract definitions
description: Reusable definitions for the Second Shift Reduction Accelerator Option A contracts. Synthetic data only. No PHI or PII. See docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-20260812-002.md.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of a contract, artifact, dataset, or instruction set.

correlationId.description: Workflow-run correlation identifier. Format CORR-YYYYMMDD-<32 lowercase hex>. Generated once per run by the experience layer. Log-safe: carries no identity, organization, patient, or encounter information. See docs/conventions/correlation-id.md.

shortReference.description: Last eight characters of the correlation identifier, shown to a user as a support reference.

utcTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp expressed in UTC with a trailing Z.

organizationId.description: Configuration key of the organization pack. Example value: harborlight.

syntheticPatientId.description: Synthetic patient identifier. The SYN-PAT- prefix makes a real medical record number structurally invalid.

syntheticPractitionerId.description: Synthetic practitioner or care-team member identifier.

artifactId.description: Identifier of a generated draft artifact.

generationId.description: Identifier of a single generation attempt.

approvalEventId.description: Identifier of a human approval decision event.

auditEventId.description: Identifier of a minimal audit event.

idempotencyKey.description: Per-attempt idempotency key. Changes on every generation attempt, including revisions.

actorRef.description: Opaque actor reference. Never carries a name, email address, user principal name, or any other direct identifier.

userRoleCode.description: Role code used for authorization scoping. Display labels come from the organization configuration pack.

draftStatus.description: Mandatory status of every generated artifact. Non-configurable and non-overridable. See docs/conventions/draft-and-safety-status.md.

lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle state after a human decision. APPROVED-SIMULATED marks a demonstration boundary and is never a finalized clinical record.

decision.description: Human decision on a draft artifact.

fhirResourceType.description: Minimal set of FHIR-shaped resource types in Option A scope.

outputSection.description: Generated output sections. No recommendation, assessment, triage, or plan section exists in P0.

failClosedCode.description: Fail-closed condition codes shared by the experience layer, the validation layer, and audit evidence.

environmentVariableName.description: Name of an environment variable. Configuration files carry the variable name only. Carrying a value is structurally invalid, which keeps endpoints, tenant identifiers, and secrets out of source control.
